    - **Tristan**. I walk the banks ahead of [Lucan](../npcs/lucan.md)'s barges and warn them what's waiting. Nine years now.
    - My brother [Edric](../npcs/edric.md) rides the road patrol. We compare notes, road against river. Lately they match more than I'd like.
    - Read the reeds, the mud, the birds. What bent the grass, which way, how long ago. An old fowler taught me as a boy. I'd rather track a beast than fight one.
    - (A long pause.) There's a stretch upstream where the river runs deep and slow between high banks. The bargehands call it the **Long Reach**.
    - The herons have left it. I ask Lucan to pass it at speed. I won't say more until I'm sure of what I'm saying.
    - Go quietly.
